about.heading: A little bit about me.
about.lead: I am an undergraduate currently pursuing a Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT) and a Bachelor of Science in Physical Science-ICT.
paragraphs: My studies have given me a foundation in programming, database management, information systems, and software development. I enjoy turning what I learn into practical projects and improving them as my skills grow.
Outside university, I enjoy reading fiction, exploring new technologies, spending time with my cat, music, language learning, and finding new ways to challenge myself.
